title: Single section-ring quotient morphism with all chart equations
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible $X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $S=\bigoplus_{m\geq0}\Gamma(X,L^{\otimes m})$ its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $d>0$, $s\in S_d$, and $U\subseteq X$ an open whose underlying set is the nonvanishing locus of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. There exists $g:U\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj] such that for every $e>0$, $t\in S_e$, $n\geq0$, and $\xi\in S_{ne}$, on the ambient image $W\subseteq X$ of $g^{-1}(D_+(t))$, the pulled-back scalar $g^\sharp(\xi/t^n)$ satisfies $g^\sharp(\xi/t^n)\cdot(t^n)|_W=\xi|_W$ in $\Gamma(W,L^{\otimes ne})$. No nonvanishing opens are assumed to cover $X$, and no agreement with any other morphism is asserted.

proof.text: Use nonvanishing_section_trivializes on L^{tensor d}. Tensor its generator s to get unique coefficients of restrictions of degree nd numerators with respect to s^n. Equality after multiplying homogeneous fractions by a power of s gives equality of coefficients by cancellation. The tensor multiplication of the section ring makes these coefficients into a unital ring map S_(s) to Gamma(U,O_X).

proof.text: Apply the affine morphism correspondence and identify Spec S_(s) with D_+(s) to obtain g. On local trivializations of L write s=b z^d and t=c z^e, with b a unit. The chart function t^d/s^e pulls back to c^d/b^e. Its unit locus is exactly where c is a unit. On that locus localization sends xi/t^n to the coefficient of xi divided by c^n, giving the stated section equation. These local equations glue. For n=0 use the tensor unit. Empty source opens have unique maps and sections.
